opening.argument: The central activity is an instructional walkthrough of registering and activating a Target Mastercard gift card. The speaker expressly states that the video will explain “how to activate and register it,” then identifies the postal-code registration step and directs viewers to “manage the PIN code.” The accompanying interfaces reinforce that explanation: the card is shown beside a phone screen with a ZIP Code field and Save button, followed by a card-management page displaying PIN controls. A separate Cash App referral promotion offers a stated reward, but that distinct promotion does not establish a deceptive mechanism or displace the video's primary educational purpose.
